decisions.reason: The Definition explicitly introduces a new cellwise constant symmetric matrix A_K and writes A|_K=A_K. Its use of def-matching-affine-simplicial-meshes imports the cells and mesh geometry, not an equation identifying the new coefficient with a reference-map matrix. No reference map F_K occurs in this Definition; the trace supplier independently denotes its geometric matrix by B. Local rebinding therefore imposes ellipticity only on the diffusion coefficient, with no restriction on the geometric map. All volume, flux and penalty expressions are well defined on the stated domain.

Step 2.1 omits a local justification for inferring positive DG energy from z_h!=0: F5 supplies only a seminorm, and F2 records only its coercivity inequality. Definiteness is true, proved in lem-sipdg-energy-seminorm-is-a-norm and used by the cited coercivity theorem, so this is a nonfatal justification omission rather than a false estimate or substantial mathematical gap. Repaired by testing ||z_h||_DG=0 directly, proving the desired bound immediately there and dividing only in the positive-energy branch. No definiteness supplier is needed by the repaired argument.

Outward signs give q_F=(r_minus-r_plus)/2 internally and r on the boundary. Positive h_F and gamma make all terms finite and symmetric. Neither definiteness nor a convergence rate is asserted here; Countable Choice is retained. No item or metadata repair is needed.

Checked all three steps against the actual form domain, exact-consistency, coercivity, inverse-flux and augmented-boundedness suppliers, and checked the owning contract/page interface. D_h is linear since weak divergence and unique normal flux traces are linear. Galerkin consistency gives a(z_h,z_h)=a(u-w_h,z_h); the inverse-flux estimate bounds its augmented norm by sqrt(1+C_flux) times DG energy. The revised zero-energy branch needs no division, and the other branch divides by an explicitly positive quantity. The D_h seminorm triangle then proves the unchanged constant and the infimum assertion without assuming a minimizer. Countable Choice and the absence of any approximation-rate claim are preserved. This is a repair review, not independent acceptance of my own edit.
